title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
summary: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning｜Long-horizon reasoning requires an agentic runtime that can persist when evidence supports its current approach

extra.description: Long-horizon reasoning requires an agentic runtime that can persist when evidence supports its current approach and pivot when measurements reveal failure, hidden constraints, or a misspecified objective. We present Argus, a persistent, self-evolving runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer execute bounded missions over durable project state.
